candidates.headline: Wise expands travel services with QR payments, eSIMs

candidates.description:
Wise has expanded QR payments and added customisable eSIM plans to its app, with customers in Singapore and Malaysia among the first globally to access both features from today. The QR payment service covers more than 50 destinations. Customers can already use PayNow QR in Singapore and DuitNow QR in Malaysia. The app also connects directly [...] 
 The post  Wise Rolls Out Overseas QR Payments, Customisable eSIM Plans  appeared first on  Fintech Singapore .

llm_fetch_required.hint: Webflow CMS listing under div.collection-list-wrapper-2.w-dyn-list. Each item is a div.div-block-78 containing a category label in div.category, a headline in div.text-block-27 (treat as the title), and a date as plain text in div.text-block-29 (e.g. 'April 28, 2026'). About 6 items shown in reverse chronological order. Resolve relative item links against https://www.ailytics.ai/.

llm_fetch_required.hint: Cellivate 'Recognition' page lists press features and awards. llm_fetch_required.hint: Craft Health 'Latest News' page is a chronological press/achievements timeline organised by year and month headers (e.g. '2021', then 'January 2021'). Each entry is a bullet line of plain text describing a media mention or award, often with an inline '[<Read_More>]' or named hyperlink to an external article. Dates come from the month/year section headings, not per-item. Resolve relative links against https://www.crafthealth.me/.

llm_fetch_required.hint: WordPress (Yoast SEO) press-release page on hicuramedical.com. Each item is a row containing a publisher logo/thumbnail, a bolded headline (in <strong> tags rather than h2/h3), a short description, and a 'View Article' link to an external publisher URL. No explicit per-item date elements; dates only appear inline within some headlines (e.g. '2023'). Resolve relative links against https://hicuramedical.com/.

llm_fetch_required.hint: Card-based blog listing on insightic.io. Resolve relative links against https://insightic.io/.
